intro: Medien und Technik is a theme you talk about every day, and its vocabulary is unusual in one way: much of it is English, but not the way you'd guess. Some words are borrowed whole and given a gender (der Computer, das Handy — which is not English at all —, die App, der Laptop, die E-Mail, das WLAN for Wi-Fi); some are German verbs built on the borrowed nouns (downloaden and herunterladen both exist, but herunterladen is the standard; speichern = save, drucken = print, klicken, hochladen = upload, ausschalten / einschalten = switch off/on); and some are plain German with no English echo at all (der Bildschirm = screen, das Gerät = device, das Passwort, der Akku = battery, die Datei = file, die Nachricht = message, die Festplatte = hard drive). Learn the verbs with their separable prefixes: Ich lade die App herunter; Schalte das Gerät aus.
tips[0].title: The verbs — mostly separable
tips[0].text: speichern (save) · drucken (print) · klicken auf · herunterladen (download) · hochladen (upload) · einschalten / ausschalten (switch on/off) · anschließen (connect) · aktualisieren (update) · löschen (delete) · sich anmelden / abmelden (log in/out).
tips[0].check.why: herunterladen is separable: lade sits in position 2 and herunter goes to the very end.
tips[1].title: The nouns and their genders
tips[1].text: der Computer, der Laptop, der Bildschirm, der Akku, der Drucker · die App, die E-Mail, die Datei, die Nachricht, die Festplatte, die Website · das Handy, das Gerät, das Passwort, das WLAN, das Programm.
tips[1].trap: das Handy is a mobile phone (not 'handy'); der Akku is a rechargeable battery (die Batterie is disposable); die Festplatte is the hard drive. And 'aktuell' means current, not actual.
tips[1].check.why: It is der Akku, a masculine noun, so the nominative article is der.
tips[2].title: Problems and fixes
tips[2].text: Der Bildschirm bleibt schwarz. Das Programm stürzt ab (crashes). Die Verbindung ist weg. Ich habe das Passwort vergessen. — neu starten (restart), aktualisieren, den Kundendienst anrufen.
tips[2].check.why: Programs crash with abstürzen: das Programm stürzt ab.
tips[3].title: herunter / hoch = down / up
tips[3].text: herunterladen (load down), hochladen (load up). Picture the arrows; the English 'download / upload' is the same pair.
tips[3].check.why: Putting something online is going up: hochladen = upload. herunterladen is download.
remember[0]: speichern – drucken – herunterladen – ausschalten: the four verbs of every tech dialogue.
remember[1]: das Handy, der Akku, die Festplatte: German words in English clothing.
mistakes[0].why: herunterladen is the standard verb; the participle is heruntergeladen.
mistakes[1].why: A rechargeable battery is der Akku.
hook: Download, save, switch it off and on again: the German words you need when your phone or laptop acts up.
